consequences: The default stays create, so scripts and old agents behave as before. Weaker matches are still listed after a create.
context: Review WP4.5, owner decision: agents created duplicates and then had to clean up.
decision: task_create takes ifSimilar: create (default) or return. With return, a match scoring 0.8 or more (STRONG_SIMILARITY) creates nothing and returns { created: false, similar }. The agent workflow tells agents to pass return.
title: task_create: ifSimilar returns strong matches instead of creating
